exposure: first trimester exposure to angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors (ACEIs)
first trimester exposure to angiotensin receptor blockers (ARBs)
cohort: 130,061 pregnancies in New South Wales, Australia, between 2005 and 2012
finding: No statistically significant association was found between first trimester exposure to ACEIs or ARBs and adverse perinatal outcomes in women with chronic hypertension compared to methyldopa exposure, although the study acknowledges limited power to detect small associations.
